basis: The US chapter connects remaining volatility, the one/five/twenty-session price pattern, household liquid-wealth depletion and the manufacturing/services split. It keeps inflation and retail earnings pending and distinguishes disinflation from a weak customer.

China distinguishes borrowing capacity from borrower demand, bank bond-trade intervention from stimulus, luxury property from structural repair, low-carbon funding from broad reflation and currency/trade pressure from shipment volumes.

Poland compares wage support with real deposit returns, the market rebound with provisions/distributions, sourcing risks with local demand, and Witcher creative news with cash generation. The security discussion preserves suspected attribution and business-specific exposure.

Sectors use specific opposing results and mechanisms: Palantir/JFrog analyst-versus-company expectations, NewsCorp/Paramount distribution economics, foreign-bank fee/lending mix, Dangote/Shell/Aramco, Caterpillar/Vestas, beverage dispersion, Lilly/CVS, Linde/Ashland and TSMC/AMD/SMIC.

Flows distinguishes household and corporate balance sheets, actual fundraising and subscriptions from ETF prices, foreign equity selling from currency positioning, and GLD diversification from identified purchases. Scenarios remain conditional and name the operating evidence that would change the call.
